problem_statement: When the network data leader parses the Commissioning Data TLV to report whether it contains an unknown extra sub-TLV, malformed sub-TLV content is mishandled. If a sub-TLV header, its extended length, or its value runs past the end of the Commissioning Data value, the parsing walk can read a type byte from a truncated sub-TLV and misclassify the malformed content as an unknown extra sub-TLV, reporting an extra TLV even though no real sub-TLV was present. Parsing the commissioning data should stop at a sub-TLV that does not fit fully within the value without reporting it as an extra TLV, while still reporting a genuine unknown sub-TLV that is complete and in-bounds.
